text: A psalm of David.Lord, I call to you; hasten to me;listen to my plea when I call.
Let my prayer be incense [1] before you;my uplifted hands [2] an evening offering. [AA]
Set a guard, Lord, before my mouth,keep watch over the door of my lips. [AB]
Do not let my heart incline to evil,to perform deeds in wickedness.On the delicacies of evildoerslet me not feast.
t[3]Let a righteous person strike me; it is mercy if he reproves me.Do not withhold oil from my head [AC]while my prayer opposes their evil deeds.
May their leaders be cast over the cliff,so that they hear that my speeches are pleasing.
Like the plowing and breaking up of the earth,our bones are strewn at the mouth of Sheol.
For my eyes are upon you, O Lord, my Lord; [AD]in you I take refuge; do not take away my soul.
Guard me from the trap they have set for me,from the snares of evildoers. [AE]
Let the wicked fall into their own nets,while only I pass over them safely.
